verdict.rationale: Belvo documents a sandbox environment for exploring its full API (belvo-docs-18). Its quickstart issues API keys and a Postman collection and walks through a simple API flow (belvo-docs-8, belvo-docs-5), which supports end-to-end linking and data retrieval testing before going live. The error-code reference (belvo-docs-28) explains real errors but does not show sandbox-triggerable error states. Missing for 10: documented test institutions, published test credentials, a way to simulate error states in the sandbox, and independent hands-on corroboration of the sandbox flow.
